item.text: The end-to-end path is now wired: server validation and header wrapping, revision-pinned chunk iteration, client forwarding, and explicit proxy/mock rejection. I’ve kept unary Range untouched; next I’m compiling the affected packages and running every local test that can exercise the new surface.
